title: Bending Spoons buys Mailchimp for $3.68B
summary: Intuit acquired the company in 2021 for roughly $12 billion, so it looks like Bending Spoons is getting quite a bargain.
llm_summary: Bending Spoons has agreed to purchase Mailchimp for about $3.68 billion, a fraction of the roughly $12 billion price tag Intuit paid when it bought the email‑marketing platform in
